chains.name: Anubis Network
chains.note: gasDAI pays gas only, so pools quote in DAI.

chains.name: Kinetiq Elysium
chains.note: HYPE is the gas coin and settles to HyperEVM. Gully Core is live on Kinetiq Elysium since 2026-11-09 (45 contracts, verified on our Sourcify, owned by the chain Safe 2-of-3).

outsideBuilders.note: Developers and launchpads outside Gully Labs pay Gully 0.30% of every trade on every pool they create, and nothing else. The Safe may lower the fee per pool; a raise waits a public notice. Source: FeeControllerV5 on each chain.

gullySurfaces.launchFee: $2, paid in the chain's native coin (fees.launch)
gullySurfaces.note: Gully's own surfaces (kre8) keep the release-2 rules. The launch fee is $2 on every chain, except where fees.launch says otherwise.

6714.line: none (gasDAI is gas-only, so the fee stays 0 until a kit that takes it in a token ships)

99901.line: 0.01 HYPE, about $0.72 (the kit's cap of 0.01 native is below $2 in HYPE)

bring-your-own-domain.title: Bring your own domain
bring-your-own-domain.description: Serve your Gully Core launchpad, DEX or stock market on a domain you own: two DNS records, no transaction, a certificate issued for you.

build-a-dex.title: Build a DEX
build-a-dex.description: A hosted exchange over Gully Core pools with your name and brand. It is the same contract as a Launchpad, and only what the site shows changes.

build-a-launchpad.title: Build a Launchpad
build-a-launchpad.description: A launch site of your own on the shared core: your name, your brand, your terms. No contracts to deploy and nothing to host.

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Where Gully Core runs, mainnets and testnet, with status read from the deployment records: a chain is live only when its record exists.

cli.title: Command line
cli.description: The gullycore command: swaps, pools, liquidity, launches, locks and fees from a terminal, with the review, the simulation and the guards built in.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Every Gully Core contract address on every chain with a deployment record, with its Sourcify verification. Read from the records, never from a copy.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: What Gully charges outside builders on Gully Core: a flat 0.30% of every trade, no kit split and no share of creator tax. How the fee can change.

hook-pools.title: Hook pools
hook-pools.description: Write a hook contract, deploy it, register it and back a live pool with it on the shared core. Covers dynamic fees, oracles, revenue share and stock hooks.

index.title: Gully Core docs
index.description: Gully Core docs for builders: launchpads, DEXes, stock markets, vaults, hook pools, orders, router, locks and splits, the SDK, the CLI, fees, chains and contracts.

launch-a-token.title: Launch a token
launch-a-token.description: One transaction creates the token, opens its pool at the market cap you choose and locks the liquidity forever. No bonding curve and no migration.

liquidity-rewards.title: Liquidity rewards
liquidity-rewards.description: A project funds a stream of tokens and the pool pays it out every second to the liquidity that is in range, in proportion to each position.

listing-kit.title: Listing kit
listing-kit.description: How the pools of your launchpad or DEX get listed on DEX Screener, GeckoTerminal and DefiLlama, and what you do to make sure they show up with the right name and links.

locks.title: Locks and vesting
locks.description: Launch liquidity is locked forever by contracts with no owner. Any CL position or token can be time-locked or vested, and every lock is public.

orders.title: Limit orders and DCA
orders.description: Sell at a price you choose, or buy a fixed amount on a schedule, on Gully Core pools. Your tokens stay in a contract you can leave at any time.

price-oracle.title: Price oracle
price-oracle.description: A time-weighted average price recorded by a pool's own hook, which one trade cannot move and any contract can read for free.

products.title: Products
products.description: What you can build on Gully Core: launchpad, DEX, stock market, vaults, hook pools, orders, router, locks and splits.

router.title: Router and swaps
router.description: Put a working swap on your page with one line of HTML, quote and swap from your own code, and see what a trade costs through the Gully Core router.

sdk.title: SDK reference
sdk.description: The Gully Core TypeScript SDK, module by module: chains, address book, launches, launchpads and DEXes, market data, locks, drops, splits and routing.

splits.title: Splits, airdrops and multisend
splits.description: Pay a team by fixed weights, airdrop a token with Merkle proofs, or send to up to 1,000 addresses in one transaction.

start.title: Start building
start.description: Start building on Gully Core: use the app, pick a chain, create a launchpad, DEX or stock market in one transaction, and use the CLI from a checkout.

stock-market.title: Stock market
stock-market.description: A hosted site that lists only tokenised-stock pairs, with market hours, price bands and issuer notes shown for each pair.

trust.title: Trust and audits
trust.description: What to trust about Gully Core: the audited core it is built on, what has no external audit, verified source, governance and licence.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.description: Put both tokens of a pool in a vault and it keeps your liquidity concentrated around the price for you, following the pool's average price.
